text.autoconfig.simpleores.title: Simple Ores
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.enable:
Off stops new silver and lead veins and hides the creative entries; existing blocks and items keep working.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.soundp:
Lead blocks on the way between a sound and the player make it quieter (world sounds only, from volume 0.3).
Default: true.

Each lead block on the way multiplies the volume by this factor. Range 0.2 to 0.9.
Default: 0.5.

A muffled sound quieter than this is not sent to the player at all. Range 0.01 to 0.3.
Default: 0.05.

Records and music devices are muffled by lead walls as well.
Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.sageOr:
Off: no new Sage Ore in the Overworld. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.dimens:
Off: no new Dimensional Scrap in any dimension. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks.
Default: true.
simpleores.guide.page.1.title: Simple Ores
simpleores.guide.page.1: Silver ore in the Overworld and the End with the silver arrow against the undead and the silver mirror, lead whose blocks muffle sound and stop the Sculk, and rose gold:
simpleores.guide.page.2.title: Simple Ores
simpleores.guide.page.2: two alloys of gold, copper and silver, pressed into bundles, smelted in the blast furnace only, with tools and armor of their own.
simpleores.guide.page.3.title: Silver
simpleores.guide.page.3: A pale metal found in the Overworld and the End. It is rarer than gold and not a tool material: it is an ingredient (rose gold) and a building metal.
simpleores.guide.page.4.title: Rose gold
simpleores.guide.page.4: Two alloys of gold, copper and silver: Rose Gold and the stronger-gold Rose Copper, which is made from Rose Gold. Made in two steps: press ingots into pressings, melt them in a blast furnace.
simpleores.guide.page.5.title: Rose gold tools and armor
simpleores.guide.page.5: Sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and a full armor set of each alloy. Both mine like iron; neither beats diamond.
simpleores.guide.page.6.title: Rose gold apples
simpleores.guide.page.6: A plain and an enchanted apple of each alloy, between the golden apple and the Netherite apple. Always edible, no cooldown.
simpleores.guide.page.7.title: Lead
simpleores.guide.page.7: A dull, heavy metal of stone and deepslate. Lead blocks stop the Sculk from hearing, withstand explosions and muffle sound - but are loud themselves.
simpleores.guide.page.8.title: Soundproofing
simpleores.guide.page.8: Lead walls make the world quieter on the other side: a TNT blast behind a few lead blocks is only a dull thud, or not heard at all.
simpleores.guide.page.9.title: Silver mirror
simpleores.guide.page.9: A wall decoration of silver and glass.
simpleores.guide.page.10.title: Enderite
simpleores.guide.page.10: The tier above netherite (moved here from SimpleLib, IG31-13). The Enderite variants of the other Simple mods - chests, furnaces, crucibles, hammers, backpacks - appear only while Simple Ores is installed.
simpleores.guide.page.11.title: Sage Ore and Dimensional Scrap
simpleores.guide.page.11: Two rare finds that moved here from SimpleBuilding (IG31-13): the sage ore with its experience orb, and the scrap of the three dimensions.
simpleores.guide.page.12.title: Settings
simpleores.guide.page.12: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
